# Branches branch-name-lint must reject: "<message> <type> <branch>".
# Unknown prefix, and a type name that is not a prefix.
[branch-prefix] feat feature/7-chart
[branch-prefix] docs docs/9-tidy
[branch-prefix] ci ci/9-tidy
# Prefix not matching the title's type.
[branch-prefix] ci feat/26-enforce-conventions
[branch-prefix] fix chore/13-fail-closed
[branch-prefix] feat fix/7-chart
# Uppercase.
[branch-slug] feat feat/7-SeaweedFS-chart
[branch-slug] feat Feat/7-chart
# Double hyphen, trailing hyphen, leading hyphen.
[branch-slug] feat feat/7-seaweedfs--chart
[branch-slug] feat feat/7-seaweedfs-chart-
[branch-slug] feat feat/-7-chart
# No issue number, no slug, leading zero, dot (ADR-0007), underscore, nested.
[branch-slug] feat feat/chart
[branch-slug] feat feat/7
[branch-slug] feat feat/07-chart
[branch-slug] feat feat/7-v1.2-chart
[branch-slug] feat feat/7_chart
[branch-slug] feat feat/7-chart/extra
# No prefix at all.
[branch-format] feat 7-chart
